definitions.explanation: An office of a company located away from its head office, usually in charge of business in a particular region.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧{支社|ししゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{転勤|てんきん}→転勤：04555_tenkin⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was transferred to the Osaka branch office.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{支社|ししゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: The company set up a branch office overseas.

examples.japanese: ⟦{本社|ほんしゃ}→本社：09565_honsha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方針|ほうしん}→方針：04871_houshin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{各地|かくち}→各地：00155_kakuchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{支社|ししゃ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{働|はたら}き{方|かた}→働き方：25439_hatarakikata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見直|みなお}された→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧。
examples.english: Because the head office changed its policy, working practices were reviewed at the branch offices around the country too.

notes:
{支|し} (branch) + ⟦{社|しゃ}→〜社：04660_sha⟧ (company). The counterpart of ⟦{本社|ほんしゃ}→本社：09565_honsha⟧ (head office).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {支社|ししゃ}{長|ちょう}: branch manager
- {支社|ししゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{転勤|てんきん}→転勤：04555_tenkin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be transferred to a branch
- ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧{支社|ししゃ}: overseas branch

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{支店|してん}→支店：03185_shiten⟧: a branch, especially of a bank or shop, where customers are served; {支社|ししゃ} is an office that runs a region's business
- ⟦{営業所|えいぎょうしょ}→営業所：23605_eigyousho⟧: a sales office, usually smaller than a {支社|ししゃ}
